note: Budget for `node scripts/consumer-size.mjs --check` (CI, P8): the cost, minified + gzip, of a Vue app built from each fixture in tests/fixtures/consumer (the Vue package, the core and the protocol bundled), minus the same app without the console (tests/fixtures/consumer/vue-only.ts). `measuredGzipBytes` is the value when the budget was last set; `maxGzipBytes` is that plus 5%, rounded up, capped at `ceilingGzipBytes` when one is set. A deliberate growth raises the budget (and the ceiling when needed) in the same change, with a one-line reason in `history`.
history: 0.0.0 (tooling, #1, 2026-10-26): first measurement on the empty packages. Each fixture imports the Vue package as a namespace and renders its export names, so the cost is the fixture's own code; the Vue piece replaces the fixtures with the composable and the component and sets the budgets from their first measure.
